summary: Openings Overview ('Your Opening World') feature fully tested. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all required elements working correctly.

minor.issue: Opening detail pages return 404 for some library_keys (e.g., 'italian-game' vs 'italian'). This is a pre-existing key mismatch issue between opening_library_service.py and opening_theory_tree.json, not related to the new OpeningsOverview feature.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking an opening row navigates to /openings/{key} but the backend returns 404 for some keys due to key mismatch (e.g., 'italian-game' vs 'italian'). This causes redirect to /openings page. Pre-existing issue, not related to new feature.
